description: A trivial copy fix with no sensitive-path, contract, migration or dependency signal, touching one file at or under triage.max_files_for_S, must classify as S and route to a direct edit — never dragged through the full /rush-pitch flow. Guards against over-triaging a one-file text fix.

given.scenario: Request: fix a typo in README.md. No config.json present, so triage.max_files_for_S uses its schema default of 3.
